data.title: Crypto industry split over Justin Drake’s AI warning
data.summary_raw: Crypto players disagree over Justin Drake’s AI cryptography warning, with some dismissing it while others urge proactive preparation.

data.title: Standard Chartered to expand crypto custody services in Singapore
data.summary_raw: The bank said the service would extend its existing crypto custody footprint in the UAE, Luxembourg, and Hong Kong.

data.title: ‘Don’t rush anything’: Vitalik Buterin warns against hasty wallet migrations amid growing AI threats
data.summary_raw: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin warned that the crypto industry should take risks to cryptography from AI-accelerated math seriously.

data.title: Samsung to launch USDC transfers on Solana for US Galaxy users
data.summary_raw: The South Korean tech giant said the feature is built into Samsung Wallet, with fiat on- and off-ramps, rather than a separate crypto app.
